dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Notice
dialogues.text: A number of suspicious outlanders have entered Inazuma lately, wandering around with seemingly sinister motives.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Notice
dialogues.text: The Shogunate hereby notifies everyone: those who report suspicious persons will be rewarded, while those who harbor them will be punished!

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Notice
dialogues.text: Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign!
